title: Cover network paths, host basename resolution and approval-mode controls for trusted Engram help
outcome: The help exception has permission-seam coverage for stated executable and approval-mode boundaries, including successful host-controlled basename resolution and file aliases.
acceptance: Production permission-seam tests deny network and UNC executable spellings, cover host-controlled bare configured-program resolution, and prove the help exception does not independently allow a request outside ReadOnlyAutoApprove.

Identity controls admit a canonical symlink alias when supported and refuse distinct copied or hard-linked path identities under the documented canonical-path contract; unsupported platform capabilities are stated explicitly.
The maintained gate passes on the final input.
